⚠ The Indigenous sovereignty track is structurally distinct: it is sovereign, not part of the GGF escalation hierarchy. Internal routing within the track
(including whether BAZ Council has a first-look role on FPIC breaches) is TBD pending Indigenous community guidance. The framework (v1.0) is explicitly
awaiting community input before operationalizing this. "Indigenous Tribunals" is an implied institution — no such body is formally named in the schema yet.
GPC spans Lanes 1 & 2. Lane 3 diverges at GJO: non-criminal → DJT, criminal → Shield Protocol. Earth Council coordinates with GPC but does not report to it.
